description.en: 2D simulations, cellular-automata, and other experiments. Built in pure JavaScript and rendered on the HTML canvas with no external libraries.
description.fr: Simulations 2D, automates cellulaires et autres expériences. Développées en JavaScript pur et rendues sur un canvas HTML sans bibliothèques externes.
description.it: Simulazioni 2D, automi cellulari e altri esperimenti. Sviluppati in JavaScript puro e renderizzati su canvas HTML senza librerie esterne.

description_short.en: A collection of modern web applications.
description_short.it: Una raccolta di moderne applicazioni web.

info.en: A web app for comparing 42 users across the 42 Network.
info.fr: Une application web pour explorer et visualiser les utilisateurs, campus, progressions et compétences du réseau 42.
info.it: Un'app web per esplorare e visualizzare utenti, campus, progressi e competenze della rete 42.

info.en: A modern IRC-inspired chat platform built around channels, rooms and communities.
info.fr: App de chat type IRC moderne (Discord) avec authentification et données persistantes.
info.it: Applicazione di chat tipo IRC moderno (Discord) con auth e database.

info.en: A full-stack photo booth and image sharing platform.
info.fr: Une plateforme full-stack de photomaton et de partage d’images.

info.it: Web-app per creare musica collegando nodi audio all'interno di un grafo React Flow.
